_about: Public-domain John Tulloch (1823-1886, Principal of St Mary's College, St Andrews) for the Word Hoard: Theism (1855), Leaders of the Reformation (1859), English Puritanism and its Leaders (1861), The Christ of the Gospels and the Christ of Modern Criticism (1864), Rational Theology and Christian Philosophy in England in the Seventeenth Century (2 vols, 1872), The Christian Doctrine of Sin (1876), Some Facts of Religion and of Life (1877), Pascal (1878), Modern Theories in Philosophy and Religion (1884) and Movements of Religious Thought in Britain (1885), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
